risk: Payload loss during runtime exception handling
consequence: If transformation fails midway in CallActivity_102, downstream monitoring cannot access the raw payload unless explicitly cached.
mitigation: CallActivity_4 sets property InputPayload before routing; CallActivity_97 enriches the body from ${property.InputPayload} and logs it as an attachment in CallActivity_100.

risk: Message dropped silently when routing conditions are not met
consequence: Sales order or return requests with unexpected OrderTypeCodes will be lost without alerting operations.
mitigation: ExclusiveGateway_80 defines default SequenceFlow_110 directing unmatched messages to EscalationEndEvent EndEvent_11 with ErrorCode RoutingConditionNotMet.

risk: Groovy XmlSlurper namespace evaluation failure on runtime updates
consequence: Updating runtime to Groovy 4 can cause XmlSlurper parsing to fail or misinterpret qualified tags.
mitigation: Script GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy explicitly imports groovy.xml.XmlSlurper and accesses nodes by local name rather than hardcoded prefixes.

consequence: Missing headers like Region or Sender could cause unhandled exceptions during logging.
mitigation: The script enforces explicit null checks prior to invoking messageLog.addCustomHeaderProperty for all headers.
